issues.detail: Participant with _id 337175 (software developer) does not have any messages in the entire channel.
All threads are below the minimum message count of 15. Thread TH1 has 14 messages, TH2 has 11, TH3 has 13, and TH4 has 13.
Thread TH1 is missing a reference to the mandatory artifact A1.
Thread TH2 is missing references to the mandatory artifacts A1 and T4.
Thread TH2 fails to make the mandatory decision D4. It is referenced in messages but not included in the thread_outcome.decisions_made list.
Thread TH3 fails to make the mandatory decision D6. It is referenced in messages but not included in the thread_outcome.decisions_made list, as it is left pending.
Participant 377231 is assigned the role 'web developer' but exclusively discusses backend topics (API endpoints, integration, JWT tokens, CI/CD), which are typical for a 'software developer'.
In thread TH4, the next_steps array incorrectly lists an artifact ID ('A2') in a 'task_id' field. Only task IDs (T*) should be used here.
Message M51 in thread TH4 incorrectly references decisions (D1-D8) from all other threads in its decision_refs, which is illogical for a single message concluding one thread.
